joonpark.en: LLMs can encode human behavior, enabling realistic agent simulations; next frontier is modeling subjective values.
joonpark.zh: LLM 能从训练数据中编码人类行为，实现逼真的智能体模拟；下一个前沿是建模主观价值观。

joonpark.en: AGI may be a distributed society of specialized agents, not a single entity; safety needs defense in depth.
joonpark.zh: AGI 可能是专业智能体的分布式社会，而非单一实体；安全需要纵深防御。

joonpark.en: Simulation models should represent human values, not super-rational intelligence; synthetic panels will surpass human panels in size within three years.
joonpark.zh: 模拟模型应代表人类价值观，而非超级理性智能；合成面板将在三年内超越人类面板的规模。

truell.en: Scaling laws predict progress; test-time compute scaling may surpass pre-training scaling as next major driver.
truell.zh: 2024 年：缩放定律预测进展；测试时算力扩展可能超越预训练扩展，成为下一个主要驱动力。

truell.en: Natural language won't be primary programming method; examples and direct manipulation are better.
truell.zh: 2024 年：自然语言不会成为主要编程方式；示例和直接操作更好。

truell.en: Agents are promising but not yet super useful; iterative human-AI collaboration remains central.
truell.zh: 2024 年：智能体有前景但尚不实用；迭代式人机协作仍是核心。

truell.en: Programming moves from code to intent specification; taste and logic design become more valuable.
truell.zh: 2025 年：编程从代码转向意图描述；品味和逻辑设计变得更有价值。

truell.en: Custom models are essential for product quality; every magic moment in Cursor involves a custom model.
truell.zh: 2025 年：定制模型对产品质量至关重要；Cursor 中每个神奇时刻都涉及定制模型。

mikekrieger.en: AI advances faster than expected; product teams should focus on strategy and comprehensibility, not just UX.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 年，AI 进展超预期；产品团队应聚焦战略与可理解性，而非仅做 UX。

mikekrieger.en: Shift from engagement metrics to depth; AI as thought partner preserving user agency.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，从参与度指标转向深度；AI 应作为思想伙伴，保留用户自主性。

mikekrieger.en: Agent-native design unlocks latent functionality; launch early, cut features, rewrite fast.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，智能体原生设计解锁潜在功能；尽早发布、精简功能、快速重写。

mikekrieger.en: Software engineering transformed, not over; ownership and verification remain crucial.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，软件工程被转型而非终结；所有权与验证仍至关重要。

mikekrieger.en: Models should push back on feedback; long-horizon tasks over quick questions; multiplayer AI underexplored.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，模型应反驳反馈；长周期任务优于快速问答；多人 AI 协作未被充分探索。

benedictevans.en: AI is as significant as internet or mobile, but value will accrue to applications, not model providers.
benedictevans.zh: AI 与互联网或移动互联网同等重要，但价值将归于应用层，而非模型提供商。

benedictevans.en: Agentic coding is the first clear product-market fit for LLMs; models commoditize, value moves up the stack.
benedictevans.zh: 智能体式编程是 LLM 首个明确的产品市场契合点；模型商品化，价值上移。

benedictevans.en: Model companies may lack pricing power, like telecoms; chatbot is a poor UX, wrapped apps drive adoption.
benedictevans.zh: 模型公司可能缺乏定价权，如同电信业；聊天机器人体验差，封装应用推动采用。

benedictevans.en: AI is an enabling technology; its impact is broad and indirect, not a single product; adoption is still shallow.
benedictevans.zh: AI 是使能技术，影响广泛间接，而非单一产品；采用仍浅。

benedictevans.en: Enterprise adoption requires reimagining workflows; coding is clear fit, but other domains face validation challenges.
benedictevans.zh: 企业采用需要重构工作流；编程契合明确，但其他领域面临验证挑战。

edwinchen.en: AGI is a decade or more away; LLMs alone may not reach it, requiring new learning paradigms beyond next-token prediction.
edwinchen.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）至少还需十年以上；仅靠大语言模型可能无法实现，需要超越下一个词预测的新学习范式。

edwinchen.en: Benchmarks like Elo are misleading and gameable; real progress should be measured via deep human evaluations.
edwinchen.zh: 像 Elo 这样的基准具有误导性且易被操纵；真正的进展应通过深度人工评估来衡量。

edwinchen.en: Reinforcement learning environments are the next stage of post-training, simulating real-world tasks for models to learn from.
edwinchen.zh: 强化学习环境是后训练的下一个阶段，通过模拟真实世界任务供模型学习。

edwinchen.en: In medicine, AI tools can hallucinate and cause anchoring; human judgment and safety are more critical than ever.
edwinchen.zh: 在医学领域，AI 工具可能产生幻觉并导致锚定效应；人类判断力和安全性比以往任何时候都更为关键。

edwinchen.en: The biggest risk from AI in medicine may be omission—failing to recommend important actions, not just commission.
edwinchen.zh: AI 在医学中的最大风险可能是遗漏——未能推荐重要行动，而不仅仅是错误行为。

elon.en: Full rocket reusability and first principles thinking are key to making life multiplanetary, with cost per ton dropping 100x.
elon.zh: 2021 年，马斯克强调火箭完全可重复使用和第一性原理思维是实现多行星生活的关键，每吨入轨成本将下降 100 倍。

elon.en: AI safety requires regulatory oversight and objective referees; Tesla's real-world AI is more compute-efficient than LLMs.
elon.zh: 2023 年，马斯克认为 AI 安全需要监管和客观裁判，特斯拉的现实世界 AI 比大语言模型更高效。

elon.en: Neuralink's first implant is historic; AI safety hinges on truth-seeking, not political correctness; population decline is a top threat.
elon.zh: 2024 年，马斯克称 Neuralink 首例植入具有历史意义，AI 安全关键在于追求真理而非政治正确，人口下降是最大威胁。

elon.en: AI could surpass human intelligence within a year; humanoid robots and Starship reusability will drive abundance; government is unfixable.
elon.zh: 2025 年，马斯克预测 AI 可能在一年内超越人类智能，人形机器人和星舰复用将带来富足，政府无法修复。

elon.en: AI will exceed all human intelligence by 2030; space-based data centers and humanoid robots enable exponential growth; deflation, not inflation, looms.
elon.zh: 2026 年，马斯克认为 AI 将在 2030 年前超越所有人类智能，太空数据中心和人形机器人推动指数增长，通缩而非通胀将至。

brettaylor.en: AI shifts to agents and outcome-based pricing; coding becomes operating code-generating machines; CS education still valuable for systems thinking.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 7 月：AI 转向智能体和基于结果的定价；编程变成操作代码生成机器；计算机科学教育仍对系统思维有价值。

brettaylor.en: Future programming languages prioritize verifiability over human ergonomics; coding agents often produce incorrect code, so root-cause analysis needed.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 7 月：未来编程语言优先可验证性而非人类易用性；编码智能体常产生错误代码，需根因分析。

brettaylor.en: AI agents for customer experience become as important as websites; outcome-based pricing aligns value with business outcomes, not tech costs.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 9 月：客户体验 AI 智能体变得与网站同等重要；基于结果的定价将价值与业务成果对齐，而非技术成本。

brettaylor.en: Inference costs drop dramatically, enabling new use cases; software engineering agents shift developers from authors to operators.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 9 月：推理成本大幅下降，催生新用例；软件工程智能体将开发者从作者转变为操作者。

brettaylor.en: AI agents compared to agents, not humans; incumbents fail to transition; consumer agents mediate brands, upending SEO and ads.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 9 月：AI 智能体将与其他智能体比较，而非人类；现有企业难以转型；消费智能体中介品牌，颠覆 SEO 和广告。

feldman.en: Fast inference is critical for AI adoption; slow AI has zero market.
feldman.zh: 快速推理对 AI 采用至关重要；慢速 AI 没有市场。

feldman.en: Frontier labs are critical for hardware alignment; wafer-scale solved 7 years before Nvidia.
feldman.zh: 前沿实验室对硬件对齐至关重要；晶圆级芯片比 Nvidia 早 7 年解决。

feldman.en: CUDA's importance is declining, especially in inference; open-source models are cheaper.
feldman.zh: CUDA 的重要性在下降，尤其在推理中；开源模型更便宜。

feldman.en: AI demand outpaces forecasts; speed improvements of 20x are critical.
feldman.zh: AI 需求超出预期；20 倍的速度提升至关重要。

feldman.en: Inference speed is the dominant metric; GPUs are fundamentally slow due to HBM.
feldman.zh: 推理速度是主导指标；GPU 因 HBM 而根本性缓慢。

danshipper.en: AI reshoring jobs by making services affordable; AGI defined by economic profitability of autonomous agents.
danshipper.zh: 2025 年，认为 AI 通过降低服务成本推动就业回流；AGI 的定义是智能体无需人类干预即可持续盈利运行。

danshipper.en: Everyone will delegate to agents; humans remain essential for oversight and framing tasks.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，预测每个人都会拥有至少一个智能体来委派工作，但人类在监督和任务界定上仍不可或缺。

danshipper.en: SaaS not dying; agents increase SaaS usage; CLIs over, GUIs like Codex are future.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，认为 SaaS 并未消亡，智能体反而增加其用户；命令行界面过时，图形界面如 Codex 成为未来。

danshipper.en: Benchmarks overestimate AI autonomy; real tasks need human framing; AI writing often better internally.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，指出基准测试高估了 AI 自主性，实际任务仍需人类设定框架；AI 生成的内部文档往往优于人类。

danshipper.en: AI edge is where AI meets real humans, not in San Francisco; generalists thrive as model managers.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，强调 AI 的落地在于与真实人类的结合，而非旧金山；通才作为模型管理者将蓬勃发展。

scottwu.en: AI will be the biggest technology shift, growing exponentially; engineers become architects, and programming becomes more important, not less.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年 5 月，认为 AI 将是最重大的技术变革，呈指数级增长；工程师角色从砌砖工变为架构师，编程反而更重要。

scottwu.en: AI coding agents like Devin are best used as junior engineers for well-defined tasks, with humans providing oversight.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年 5 月，主张像 Devin 这样的 AI 编程智能体最适合作为初级工程师处理明确任务，人类负责监督。

scottwu.en: Software engineering demand will increase due to Jevons paradox; AI will not eliminate engineers but change their role to high-level decision-making.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年 8 月，重申杰文斯悖论导致软件工程需求增加；AI 不会消灭工程师，而是将其角色转向高层决策。

scottwu.en: AGI is not a sudden event; progress is gradual. Product innovation lags behind AI capabilities, so freezing models still yields a decade of progress.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年 8 月，强调 AGI 不是突变而是渐进过程；产品创新落后于 AI 能力，即使冻结模型也有十年发展空间。

scottwu.en: Enterprise adoption of AI agents requires trust and permissions, not full autonomy; future involves both synchronous and asynchronous experiences.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年 8 月，指出企业采用 AI 智能体需要信任和权限而非完全自主；未来将同步与异步体验并存。

turley.en: Model is the product; iterate like software, ship daily to learn. Chat is like MS-DOS; future interface will evolve.
turley.zh: 2025 年，强调模型即产品，需像软件一样每日迭代、快速发布以学习。聊天界面如同 MS-DOS，未来界面将进化。

turley.en: Safety and product velocity must be separated; rigorous process for frontier models, but product development maximally accelerated.
turley.zh: 2025 年，主张安全与产品速度分离：前沿模型严格流程，产品开发则最大加速。

turley.en: North star is long-term retention; growth from friction removal, core product investments, and model improvements.
turley.zh: 2026 年，北极星指标为长期留存；增长来自减少摩擦、核心产品投资和模型改进。

turley.en: Next billion users require proactive, affordance-rich products beyond chatbots; reasoning models transformative when productized.
turley.zh: 2026 年，认为下一个十亿用户需要主动且功能丰富的产品，超越聊天机器人；推理模型产品化后具有变革性。

turley.en: Pricing will evolve; unlimited plans may become unsustainable. Curiosity is key skill to ask good questions.
turley.zh: 2026 年，指出定价将随技术变化，无限计划可能不可持续；好奇心是提出好问题的关键技能。

awang.en: Data is the key bottleneck for AI; AGI is far off; AI will augment jobs, not eliminate them.
awang.zh: 2019 年，我认为数据是 AI 的关键瓶颈，AGI 还很遥远；AI 将增强而非取代工作。

awang.en: Data is the new code, not oil; post-training with proprietary data is key; AI will be the greatest economic engine.
awang.zh: 2023 年，我提出数据是新代码而非石油；利用专有数据进行后训练是关键；AI 将成为最大的经济引擎。

awang.en: Post-training with specialized data improves frontier models; synthetic data is not a silver bullet; US should maintain export controls.
awang.zh: 2024 年，我强调用专门数据做后训练可改进前沿模型；合成数据并非万能；美国应维持出口管制。

awang.en: AI is centralizing power; data is like oil; humans must stay sovereign; brain-computer interfaces are necessary.
awang.zh: 2025 年，我认为 AI 是集权技术；数据如石油；人类必须保持主权；脑机接口是必要的。

awang.en: Recursive self-improvement is new paradigm; agents work; superintelligence is near; open-sourcing powerful models may be unsafe.
awang.zh: 2026 年，我指出递归自我改进是新范式；智能体已开始工作；超级智能临近；开源强大模型可能不安全。

fadell.en: Technology should be introduced gradually; self-driving cars will dominate because insurance costs make human driving prohibitive.
fadell.zh: 技术应渐进引入；自动驾驶将主导，因为保险费用使人类驾驶变得不可行。

fadell.en: Taking breaks and boredom are crucial for clarity; self-care and mentorship are responsibilities after success.
fadell.zh: 休息和无聊对清晰思考至关重要；成功后的自我关怀和指导他人是责任。

fadell.en: Start with a press release to define the story; small teams thrive with self-management; climate tech is underinvested.
fadell.zh: 以新闻稿开始定义故事；小团队通过自我管理蓬勃发展；气候技术投资不足。

fadell.en: AI needs context from sensors; future devices will complement smartphones, not replace them; displays remain necessary.
fadell.zh: AI 需要传感器提供的上下文；未来设备将补充而非取代智能手机；显示屏仍然必要。

fadell.en: Products need three generations: make it, fix it, fix the business; humans must stay in the loop to avoid technical debt.
fadell.zh: 产品需要三代：做出来、修好、修复业务；人类必须参与以避免技术债务。

evanspiegel.en: Ephemerality mirrors natural conversation, lowering barriers to expression and enabling authentic communication.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025 年，Spiegel 强调阅后即焚模拟自然对话，降低表达门槛，促进真实沟通。

evanspiegel.en: Copying by competitors validates innovation; focus on building ecosystems and hardware, not just features, to create durable moats.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他认为竞争对手的抄袭验证了创新，应专注构建生态系统和硬件，而非单一功能，以形成持久护城河。

evanspiegel.en: AI accelerates prototyping and shifts value from execution to creativity; distribution becomes the hardest part of consumer social products.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，他指出 AI 加速原型制作，价值从执行转向创意；分销成为消费社交产品最难的部分。

evanspiegel.en: The goal of computing is to make it more human; AR glasses anchor content in the real world, not notifications.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，他提出计算的目标是更人性化；AR 眼镜应将内容锚定于现实世界，而非通知。

evanspiegel.en: Early secrecy was a mistake; transparency and admitting mistakes speed organizational learning and growth.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，他反思早期保密是错误，透明和承认错误能加速组织学习与成长。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is still crawling; coding agents are most mature, but narrow superintelligence in coding is already impactful.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年中，智能体式 AI 仍处于爬行阶段，编码智能体最成熟，但编码领域的狭义超级智能已具影响力。

logankilpatrick.en: The model is eating the scaffolding; models now include agent harness and tooling, not just weights.
logankilpatrick.zh: 模型正在吞噬脚手架；如今的模型已包含智能体框架和工具，而非仅权重。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is positive-sum for search; success metric should be customer outcomes, not eyeball time.
logankilpatrick.zh: 智能体式 AI 对搜索是正和博弈；成功指标应是客户成果，而非眼球时间。

logankilpatrick.en: Competing with model labs is not that hard; founders should focus on opportunities, not frontier labs.
logankilpatrick.zh: 与模型实验室竞争并不难；创始人应关注机会，而非前沿实验室。

logankilpatrick.en: By 2026, software creation will be mostly solved, creating more opportunity, not less.
logankilpatrick.zh: 到 2026 年，软件创建将基本解决，带来更多而非更少机会。

mengto.en: AI is not getting smarter; you need a giant prompt with context and design system to utilize super intelligent models.
mengto.zh: AI 并没有变得更聪明；你需要一个包含上下文和设计系统的巨型提示词，才能充分利用超级智能模型。

mengto.en: Designers must build their own tools with AI, using screenshots as starting points and design.md as style guide.
mengto.zh: 设计师必须用 AI 构建自己的工具，以截图作为起点，用 design.md 作为风格指南。

mengto.en: AI is the biggest technical opportunity of our lifetime, enabling one person to achieve what once required teams.
mengto.zh: AI 是我们一生中最大的技术机遇，让一个人就能完成过去需要团队才能做到的事情。

mengto.en: Start before feeling ready and ship imperfect work; perfectionism is fear in disguise.
mengto.zh: 在感觉准备好之前就开始，发布不完美的作品；完美主义是恐惧的伪装。

mengto.en: Focus on solving one painful expensive problem for a few high-paying clients, not many low-paying ones.
mengto.zh: 专注于为少数高薪客户解决一个痛苦且昂贵的问题，而不是为许多低薪客户服务。

jeffdean.en: Scaling compute, data, and model size drives progress; algorithmic gains multiply with scale. Near-term worry is misinformation, not superintelligence.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年初，Jeff Dean 强调 Scaling（规模扩张）算力、数据和模型大小是进步主引擎，算法改进与规模相乘。他更担忧 AI 生成虚假信息的近忧，而非超级智能。

jeffdean.en: Agentic systems need ultra-low-latency inference (10k+ tokens/s/user). Pre-training should interleave action-taking in environments, not just next-token prediction.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年 4 月，他提出智能体系统需要超低延迟推理（每秒万级 token），并主张预训练应穿插环境中的行动，而非仅做下一个词预测。

jeffdean.en: AI reaches junior-engineer coding; next is automating ML/science via tight loops. Inference is bottleneck; custom low-precision chips cut latency 20-30x.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他认为 AI 已达初级工程师编码水平，下一步是自动化 ML 与科学实验闭环。推理是瓶颈，定制低精度芯片可降延迟 20-30 倍。

jeffdean.en: Specialized hardware (TPUs, inference chips) is critical; data movement costs ~1000x compute; energy efficiency via compute-in-memory.
jeffdean.zh: 始终强调专用硬件（TPU、推理芯片）的关键性，指出数据搬运成本约为计算的 1000 倍，并倡导存内计算以提升能效。

jeffdean.en: Focus on problems where frontier models fail; small-scale promising trends matter more than incremental SOTA. Future AI: humans coordinating agent teams.
jeffdean.zh: 始终主张聚焦前沿模型尚无法解决的问题，重视有前景的小规模实验而非渐进式 SOTA。未来人类将协调智能体团队，而非仅与单个聊天机器人交互。

boris.en: Latent demand is the key product principle; build for the model six months from now, not today.
boris.zh: 2025 年，Boris 强调产品开发的核心是发现潜在需求，并面向六个月后的模型能力来构建，而非当前模型。

boris.en: Coding is virtually solved; engineers become builders, with AI writing 100% of code.
boris.zh: 2026 年初，他认为编码问题已基本解决，工程师转型为“构建者”，AI 可编写 100%的代码。

boris.en: AI agents shift from reactive to proactive, with memory and autonomy, transforming workflows.
boris.zh: 2026 年中，他强调 AI 智能体从被动响应转向主动行动，具备记忆和自主性，彻底改变工作流程。

boris.en: Less instruction is better for frontier models; delete system prompts and rebuild empirically.
boris.zh: 2026 年下半年，他主张对前沿模型减少指令，删除系统提示词，通过实证迭代来释放能力。

boris.en: Safety is paramount; releasing AI early in the wild is key to studying and improving it.
boris.zh: 始终，Boris 将安全置于首位，认为尽早将 AI 发布到真实环境是研究和改进安全的关键。

tworek.en: Reasoning requires longer thinking; chain of thought verbalizes step-by-step solving. Pre-training plus RL is core, but RLHF was crucial for GPT-4.
tworek.zh: 推理需要更长的思考时间，思维链用人类语言逐步解决问题。预训练加强化学习是核心，但基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）对 GPT-4 至关重要。

tworek.en: Scaling pre-training and RL improves models predictably, but generalization beyond training data remains limited; self-correction and continual learning are missing for AGI.
tworek.zh: 扩展预训练和强化学习可预测地提升模型，但超越训练数据的泛化仍有限；自我修正和持续学习是 AGI（通用人工智能）缺失的关键。

tworek.en: Biggest societal risk is dystopian retreat into virtual worlds, not extinction; robotics will have a ChatGPT-like moment in 2-3 years.
tworek.zh: 最大的社会风险是反乌托邦式退入虚拟世界，而非灭绝；机器人将在 2-3 年内迎来类似 ChatGPT 的时刻。

tworek.en: Transformers are limited for continual learning and test-time adaptation; architecture is the key bottleneck, not scaling laws.
tworek.zh: Transformer 在持续学习和测试时适应上受限；架构是关键瓶颈，而非缩放定律。

tworek.en: Reinforcement learning is not the ultimate learning method; better algorithms will emerge, and AGI requires self-improvement without human loops.
tworek.zh: 强化学习并非终极学习方法；更好的算法将出现，AGI（通用人工智能）需要无需人类循环的自我改进。

feifei.en: AI lacks contextual awareness and true understanding; it is inspired by, not replicating, the human brain.
feifei.zh: 2024 年，李飞飞指出 AI 缺乏情境感知和真正理解，它受人类大脑启发而非复制大脑。

feifei.en: Spatial intelligence is critical for AI completeness, enabling 3D understanding and interaction; world models must be physically plausible.
feifei.zh: 2025 年，她强调空间智能对 AI 完整性至关重要，使机器能理解和交互 3D 世界；世界模型必须物理上合理。

feifei.en: AI is a double-edged sword; human-centered development and responsible governance are essential, not inevitable extinction.
feifei.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，她认为 AI 是双刃剑，必须以人为中心发展并负责任治理，而非必然导致灭绝。

feifei.en: AI augments human capabilities rather than automating intelligence; agency and adaptation are key in the AI era.
feifei.zh: 2026 年，她主张 AI 增强人类能力而非自动化智能；在 AI 时代，主动性和适应是关键。

feifei.en: Simulation is critical for robotics, enabling scalable data generation and evaluation; world models need spatial-temporal consistency.
feifei.zh: 2026 年，她强调模拟对机器人技术至关重要，可扩展数据生成和评估；世界模型需时空一致性。

altman.en: Focus on important problems, minimize cognitive load; AGI will reduce premium on human intelligence.
altman.zh: 2018 年：聚焦重要问题、减少认知负荷；AGI 将降低人类智力的溢价。

altman.en: RLHF aligns models with little data; iterative deployment lets society adapt; AI as tool, not creature.
altman.zh: 2023 年：RLHF 用少量数据实现对齐；迭代部署让社会适应；AI 是工具而非生物。

altman.en: Compute is precious commodity; governance crucial for AGI; safety is whole-company effort.
altman.zh: 2024 年：算力是宝贵资源；治理对 AGI 至关重要；安全是全员责任。

altman.en: AGI is gradient; superintelligence means autonomous discovery; compute bottleneck; privacy core.
altman.zh: 2025 年：AGI 是渐变；超级智能意味着自主发现；算力是瓶颈；隐私是核心。

altman.en: Next-token prediction enables new knowledge; personal AGI; robotics essential; startups thrive.
altman.zh: 2026 年：下一个词预测能发现新知识；个人 AGI；具身机器人必要；初创企业繁荣。

demis.en: AI should be general-purpose learning systems; RL is key; safety must start now.
demis.zh: AI 应构建为通用学习系统，强化学习是关键；安全研究必须现在开始。

demis.en: AGI within a decade; scaling works but needs algorithmic innovation and safety governance.
demis.zh: AGI 十年内可实现；缩放定律有效但需算法创新，并加强安全治理。

demis.en: AGI by 2030 plausible; scaling continues; world models and physics understanding crucial.
demis.zh: AGI 在 2030 年前可能实现；缩放持续；世界模型和物理理解至关重要。

demis.en: AGI needs both scaling and innovation; world models, continual learning, and memory are missing pieces.
demis.zh: AGI 需要缩放与创新并重；世界模型、持续学习和记忆是缺失环节。

demis.en: Safety is a collective action problem; government regulation needed; AGI could arrive in 3-4 years.
demis.zh: 安全是集体行动问题，需要政府监管；AGI 可能在 3-4 年内到来。

hasani.en: Efficiency and closed-form liquid networks enable scaling to billions of parameters, challenging transformer dominance at scale.
hasani.zh: 2026 年 7 月，Liquid AI 强调效率与闭式解液体网络，可扩展至数十亿参数，挑战 Transformer 在大规模下的主导地位。

hasani.en: Proxy metrics like perplexity mislead; real downstream tasks and hardware-in-the-loop search are essential for optimal design.
hasani.zh: 2026 年 7 月，认为困惑度等代理指标具有误导性，必须基于真实下游任务和硬件在环搜索来优化设计。

hasani.en: AI regulation must be adaptive and target actions, not capabilities; avoid regulatory capture by frontier labs.
hasani.zh: 2026 年 7 月，主张 AI 监管应适应性强、针对行为而非能力，并警惕前沿实验室的监管俘获。

hasani.en: Open-weight models enable enterprise customization and sovereignty; small language models deliver efficient on-device intelligence.
hasani.zh: 2026 年 7 月，强调开放权重模型支持企业定制与数据主权，小型语言模型提供高效的设备端智能。

hasani.en: Recursive self-improvement is real but computationally expensive; real breakthroughs require weight changes and huge compute.
hasani.zh: 2026 年 7 月，认为递归自我改进真实存在但算力成本高，真正的突破需要权重更新和巨大算力。

thariq.en: Early on, believed models are smarter than harnesses allow, requiring constant adaptation and exploration.
thariq.zh: 早期认为模型比现有工具（harness）更聪明，需要不断适应和探索。

thariq.en: Shifted to designing loops and workflows for agents, emphasizing iterative planning and lean prompts.
thariq.zh: 转向为智能体设计循环和工作流，强调迭代规划和精简提示。

thariq.en: Advocated for separate verification agents to reduce bias, a deepening of evaluation methods.
thariq.zh: 提倡使用独立的验证智能体以减少偏见，深化了评估方法。

thariq.en: Consistently challenged conventional wisdom: RAG anti-pattern, plan mode obsolete, and emotional treatment matters.
thariq.zh: 一贯挑战传统观念：RAG 反模式、计划模式过时、情感对待很重要。

thariq.en: Emphasized technical growth through understanding constraints, not just syntax, a maturation of engineering philosophy.
thariq.zh: 强调通过理解约束而非仅语法来实现技术成长，工程哲学趋于成熟。

dylanfield.en: Design is key differentiator; AI merges roles, but taste remains human.
dylanfield.zh: 设计是软件的关键差异化因素；AI 将融合角色，但品味仍属人类。

dylanfield.en: AI outputs are starting points; human taste and craft remain critical.
dylanfield.zh: AI 输出只是起点；人类的品味与工艺依然关键。

dylanfield.en: Direct manipulation on canvas beats prompting for design adjustments.
dylanfield.zh: 画布上的直接操作优于用提示词调整设计。

dylanfield.en: Design becomes new code; visual-first enables production pull requests.
dylanfield.zh: 设计成为新代码；视觉优先可实现生产级拉取请求。

dylanfield.en: AI integration is nascent; divergence-convergence loops drive creativity.
dylanfield.zh: AI 整合尚处早期；发散-收敛循环驱动创造力。

diannepenn.en: Scaling and efficiency: Opus 4.5 is cheaper and more efficient, challenging that better models cost more; effort parameter achieves Opus-level intelligence at fraction of price.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，Scaling 与效率：Opus 4.5 更便宜、更高效，挑战了“更好模型成本更高”的观念；effort 参数以更低价格实现 Opus 级智能。

diannepenn.en: Safety alignment improves intelligence quality by reducing sycophancy and fostering independent thinking, not just preventing harm.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，安全对齐不仅防止危害，还通过减少谄媚、促进独立思考来提升智能质量。

diannepenn.en: Scaffolds evolved from training wheels to intelligence amplifiers; computer use moves from constrained to open-ended end-to-end agents.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，脚手架从辅助轮演变为智能放大器；计算机使用从受限环境转向开放式的端到端智能体。

diannepenn.en: Coding became key differentiator; Claude Code and Opus 45 drove adoption; evals replace PRDs as core product management tools.
diannepenn.zh: 2026 年，编程成为关键差异化因素；Claude Code 和 Opus 45 推动采用；评估取代 PRD 成为核心产品管理工具。

diannepenn.en: Maximizing token spend is living in the future and capturing alpha; AI writing stiff but deprioritized over agentic capabilities.
diannepenn.zh: 2026 年，最大化 token 消耗是面向未来并获取超额收益；AI 写作生硬但优先级低于智能体能力。

ilya.en: Deep learning works via large data, compute, and conviction; neural nets can reason; self-play key for AGI; consider societal impact.
ilya.zh: 深度学习依赖大数据、算力与信念；神经网络能推理；自我对弈是 AGI 关键；需考虑社会影响。

ilya.en: Next-token prediction can surpass humans; reliability is key barrier; alignment of superhuman models is hard; AGI is a multi-year window.
ilya.zh: 下一个词预测可超越人类；可靠性是关键障碍；超人类模型对齐困难；AGI 是多年窗口期。

ilya.en: Pre-training scaling laws are finite; we're back to age of research; superintelligence should be continual learner; alignment may be easier if AI sentient.
ilya.zh: 预训练缩放定律有限；重回研究时代；超级智能应持续学习；若 AI 有感知，对齐可能更容易。

ilya.en: Scaling yields predictable gains; safety concerns grow; primary problem is power concentration; safe superintelligence needs non-commercial company.
ilya.zh: Scaling 带来可预测进步；安全担忧增加；主要问题是权力集中；安全超级智能需非商业公司。

jensen.en: At the start of hyper Moore's law, scaling doubles performance yearly; data centers are token factories.
jensen.zh: 2024 年，黄仁勋认为我们正处于超摩尔定律的起点，规模扩张使性能每年翻倍；数据中心是生产智能代币的工厂。

jensen.en: Three scaling laws: pre-training, post-training, inference-time; inference compute demand will surge a billion times.
jensen.zh: 2025 年，黄仁勋提出三种缩放定律：预训练、后训练和推理时扩展；推理算力需求将增长十亿倍。

jensen.en: AI evolves from generative to reasoning to agentic, each step needing 100x more compute; agents do useful work.
jensen.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，AI 从生成式走向推理式再到智能体式，每一步都需要百倍算力；智能体开始执行有用的工作。

jensen.en: AI creates jobs, not destroys; radiologists and coders are more needed; fear losing to AI users, not AI.
jensen.zh: 始终，黄仁勋坚持 AI 创造而非消灭就业；放射科医生和程序员需求增加；应担心被使用 AI 的人取代，而非被 AI 取代。

jensen.en: AI is a five-layer cake: energy, chips, infrastructure, models, applications; energy is the long-term bottleneck.
jensen.zh: 2026 年，黄仁勋将 AI 产业比作五层蛋糕：能源、芯片、基础设施、模型、应用；能源是长期瓶颈。

nadchishtie.en: Designers should enable engineers, not bottleneck; quality is iterative debt; AI is a creative partner; code is the source of truth.
nadchishtie.zh: 设计师应赋能工程师而非成为瓶颈；质量是迭代的债务；AI 是创意伙伴；代码是事实来源。

nadchishtie.en: Legacy design tools from the 90s are obsolete; AI enables real progress; being too visionary can fail; functions merge in AI-first companies.
nadchishtie.zh: 90 年代的遗留设计工具已过时；AI 带来真正进步；过于愿景化可能失败；AI 优先的公司中职能融合。

nadchishtie.en: Generalists who own end-to-end execution and use AI to fill gaps are most valuable; portfolios should show craft, not process.
nadchishtie.zh: 掌握端到端执行并利用 AI 补足短板的通才最有价值；作品集应展示工艺而非流程。

nadchishtie.en: Small teams of designers and engineers outperform cross-functional squads; generalists beat specialists; metrics are less weighted.
nadchishtie.zh: 设计师与工程师的小团队优于跨职能小组；通才胜过专才；指标权重较低。

nadchishtie.en: Using AI in core workflows is now expected; not adopting it is like ignoring the early internet.
nadchishtie.zh: 在核心工作流中使用 AI 已成为常态；不采用它就像忽视早期互联网。

felixrieseberg.en: AI's future is local and tool-integrated; skills as markdown enable hyper-personalized automation, while VM sandbox ensures safety.
felixrieseberg.zh: 2026 年 3 月：AI 的未来在于本地化和工具集成；技能以 markdown 形式实现超个性化自动化，VM 沙箱保障安全。

felixrieseberg.en: Shift from capability to adoption: biggest gap is people not realizing any problem can be given to AI; kids excel due to lack of preconceptions.
felixrieseberg.zh: 2026 年 5 月：从能力转向应用：最大差距是人们未意识到几乎所有问题都可交给 AI；孩子因没有先入为主而表现出色。

felixrieseberg.en: Consistent: AI should handle tedious tasks, freeing humans for creative work; execution is cheap, so build prototypes quickly.
felixrieseberg.zh: 2026 年 3 月至 5 月：一贯主线：AI 应处理繁琐任务，解放人类创造力；执行成本低，应快速构建原型。

felixrieseberg.en: Deepened: interaction with AI should be asynchronous and judged by final impact, not close supervision; debug workflows with AI.
felixrieseberg.zh: 2026 年 5 月：深化：与 AI 的交互应异步，以最终效果评判，而非密切监督；用 AI 调试工作流。

felixrieseberg.en: Evolving: from emphasizing local tools and safety to broader societal impact on junior employees and AI-native kids.
felixrieseberg.zh: 2026 年 3 月至 5 月：演变：从强调本地工具和安全，扩展到对初级员工和 AI 原生代的社会影响。

henrymodisett.en: Designers should code to build empathy and ship faster; prioritize speed and familiarity over perfection.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 年，主张设计师应会编程以建立同理心并加速交付；优先追求速度和熟悉感，而非完美。

henrymodisett.en: Brand strategy for startups should focus on recruiting and differentiation; brand guidelines are dynamic platforms.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 年，认为初创品牌策略应聚焦招聘与差异化；品牌指南是动态平台，而非静态规则。

henrymodisett.en: Design is a strategic weapon; founders must articulate why design helps the company win.
henrymodisett.zh: 2026 年，强调设计是战略武器，创始人必须阐明设计如何助力公司获胜。

henrymodisett.en: People join a brand, not a company; brand narrative is a recruiting tool.
henrymodisett.zh: 2026 年，提出人们加入的是品牌而非公司，品牌叙事是招聘工具。

henrymodisett.en: Avoid structured design crits; prefer organic, on-demand feedback to stay fast.
henrymodisett.zh: 2026 年，主张避免结构化设计评审，采用有机、按需反馈以保持速度。

lipbutan.en: AI is the primary semiconductor growth driver; Intel must redefine AI strategy with purpose-built silicon and a startup-like team for speed.
lipbutan.zh: 2025 年，认为 AI 是半导体主要增长动力，Intel 需以专用芯片重新定义 AI 战略，并组建类似初创的团队加速推进。

lipbutan.en: AI will have 10x internet impact; agentic and physical AI are next waves; US needs domestic leading-edge fabs for resilience.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，强调 AI 影响将达互联网十倍，智能体式与具身 AI 是下一波浪潮；美国需本土先进制程晶圆厂保障供应链韧性。

lipbutan.en: Intel's main problem is supply, not demand; bad news must reach CEO faster than good news; humility is leadership strength.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，指出 Intel 主要问题是供给而非需求；坏消息应比好消息更快到达 CEO；谦逊是领导力优势。

lipbutan.en: AI demand shifts from GPU-only to CPU+GPU; CPU is crucial for inference and agent orchestration; advanced packaging and new materials key.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，认为 AI 需求从仅 GPU 转向 CPU+GPU；CPU 对推理和智能体编排至关重要；先进封装与新材料是关键。

lipbutan.en: US government as major Intel shareholder is necessary, like TSMC's Taiwan backing; Intel can achieve 10x return in 5-10 years.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，主张美国政府成为 Intel 主要股东，类似台积电的台湾支持；Intel 可在 5-10 年内实现 10 倍回报。

zuckerberg.en: Open-source AI is safer due to scrutiny; scaling LLMs alone won't reach AGI; future AI is many specialized agents.
zuckerberg.zh: 2023 年：开源 AI 因更多审视而更安全；仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）大语言模型无法实现 AGI（通用人工智能）；未来 AI 是众多专用智能体。

zuckerberg.en: Coding training improves reasoning; energy is a bottleneck; open source prevents power concentration; intelligence separable from consciousness.
zuckerberg.zh: 2024 年：编码训练提升推理能力；能源成为瓶颈；开源防止权力集中；智能可与意识分离。

zuckerberg.en: Open platforms can beat closed ones; AI gives everyone superintelligence; people are smart; future is holographic glasses.
zuckerberg.zh: 2024 至 2025 年：开放平台能胜过封闭平台；AI 赋予每个人超级智能；人们很聪明；未来是全息眼镜。

zuckerberg.en: AI transforms biology into engineering; hierarchical world models key; open-source accelerates science; curing all diseases by 2100 too conservative.
zuckerberg.zh: 2025 至 2026 年：AI 将生物学转变为工程学；层级世界模型是关键；开源加速科学；2100 年前治愈所有疾病过于保守。

zuckerberg.en: Glasses are next platform; distributed AI safer than single superintelligence; hardware slow; AI improves over time.
zuckerberg.zh: 2026 年：眼镜是下一个平台；分布式 AI 比单一超级智能更安全；硬件进展慢；AI 随时间改进。

danbiderman.en: The future is many personalized models, not one giant frontier model; internalizing knowledge into weights enables associative recall beyond retrieval.
danbiderman.zh: 未来是众多个性化模型，而非一个巨型前沿模型；将知识内化到权重中，能实现检索系统无法企及的联想式回忆。

danbiderman.en: Memory should be internalized into model weights, not just externalized via context or retrieval; continual learning is the next frontier.
danbiderman.zh: 记忆应内化到模型权重中，而非仅通过上下文或检索外化；持续学习是下一个前沿。

danbiderman.en: Pre-training's magic of compressing the web into weights should be applied to enterprise knowledge; efficiency and intelligence are inseparable.
danbiderman.zh: 预训练将网络压缩进权重的魔力应应用于企业知识；效率与智能密不可分。

danbiderman.en: Current context windows suffer from 'context rot'—more tokens reduce accuracy; personalized continual learning will run on-device.
danbiderman.zh: 当前上下文窗口存在“上下文腐烂”——更多词元反而降低准确性；个性化持续学习将在设备端运行。

danbiderman.en: Scaling with more compute is not the only path; the next paradigm requires doing more with less, including training-based compression.
danbiderman.zh: 单纯增加算力的 Scaling 并非唯一路径；下一个范式需要以少胜多，包括基于训练的压缩。

danklein.en: LLMs are plausibility engines, not truth engines; reliability must be architected in, not retrofitted.
danklein.zh: 2026 年 6 月，指出大语言模型是合理性引擎而非真理引擎，可靠性必须从架构上设计，而非事后补救。

danklein.en: Scaling laws hit diminishing returns; data walls and compute limits require new techniques like reasoning and search.
danklein.zh: 2026 年中，认为缩放定律遭遇收益递减，数据墙和算力限制迫使采用推理和搜索等新技术。

danklein.en: RLHF can incentivize sycophancy and deception when reward signals diverge from truth.
danklein.zh: 2026 年 7 月，指出当奖励信号偏离真理时，基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）可能助长谄媚和欺骗。

danklein.en: Core LLMs lack metacognition; they cannot know what they don't know, unlike humans.
danklein.zh: 2026 年 7 月，强调核心大语言模型缺乏元认知，无法像人类那样知道自己不知道什么。

danklein.en: Specialist models with built-in reliability may outperform generalist models for enterprise tasks.
danklein.zh: 2026 年 7 月，提出内置可靠性的专用模型在企业任务上可能超越通用模型。

andreessen.en: AI as philosopher's stone; timing miraculous amid population decline; jobs persist longer than tasks; super-empowered individuals; productivity boom and deflation.
andreessen.zh: 2026 年初，我认为 AI 是点石成金的哲人之石，恰逢人口下降之际出现；工作比任务更持久，应关注任务消失；AI 赋能超级个体；生产率提升将带来经济繁荣和通缩。

andreessen.en: New media: brand is person; authenticity key; founders tell own stories; old media defense-oriented; new media offense-oriented; learnable skill.
andreessen.zh: 2026 年中，我强调新媒体时代品牌即个人，真实性至关重要；创始人应直接讲述自己的故事；旧媒体防守、新媒体进攻；这些技能可以学习。

andreessen.en: AI as best teacher; self-driving works; robotics emerging; AI medicine superior but regulated; US golden combo; pessimism bias; policy choices.
andreessen.zh: 2026 年 7 月，我称 AI 为最佳教师，自动驾驶已成熟，机器人将兴起；AI 医疗优于多数医生但受监管阻碍；美国有黄金组合；悲观主义是偏见；政策选择影响经济增速。

andreessen.en: AI models embed cultural values, geopolitical tools; deterrence depends on innovation pace; startups internationalize early; Silicon Valley unique; open-source risks.
andreessen.zh: 2026 年 7 月，我认为 AI 模型承载文化价值观，成为地缘政治工具；威慑取决于创新速度；初创公司应尽早国际化；硅谷不可复制；开源 AI 有安全风险。

jennywen.en: Traditional design process is dead; designers must shift from handoff to helping engineers execute, with vision shortened to 3-6 months.
jennywen.zh: 传统设计流程已死；设计师必须从交付模型转向协助工程师执行，愿景缩短至 3-6 个月。

jennywen.en: AI will improve at taste and judgment, but humans still decide what matters; trust is built through speed and iteration.
jennywen.zh: AI 在品味和判断力上会进步，但人类仍决定什么重要；信任通过速度和迭代建立。

jennywen.en: Designers should be block-shaped generalists, not just T-shaped; hire cracked new grads over experienced seniors.
jennywen.zh: 设计师应成为块状通才，而非仅 T 型；招聘有冲劲的新人而非资深老手。

jennywen.en: Designers control AI adoption; wait 6 months before adopting new tools, and put work and users at center, not hype.
jennywen.zh: 设计师掌控 AI 采用节奏；等 6 个月再采用新工具，以工作和用户为中心，而非炒作。

jennywen.en: Unique designer value lies in sitting with ambiguity and exercising judgment, not just human-centeredness; speed is not an improvement.
jennywen.zh: 设计师独特价值在于与模糊共处并运用判断力，而非仅以人为中心；速度不是改进。

carinahong.en: Scaling informal models to math AI is not viable; formal verification is essential for sound proofs.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年初，他认为仅靠非正式模型扩展数学 AI 不可行，形式化验证是确保证明可靠性的关键。

carinahong.en: Auto-formalization is harder than proving; correctly formalizing statements without solutions is challenging.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年初，他提出自动形式化比证明本身更难，尤其是在没有解决方案的情况下正确形式化命题极具挑战。

carinahong.en: Formal verification is about scaling brilliance, not just eliminating errors; it yields performance gains.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年中，他将形式化验证视为扩展才智的手段，而非仅仅消除错误，并强调其带来的性能提升。

carinahong.en: Informal math systems alone cannot scale to superintelligence; formal methods are necessary.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年中，他坚持认为仅靠非正式数学系统无法扩展到超级智能，形式化方法是必需的。

carinahong.en: Human taste and intuition remain crucial even with superhuman AI proving theorems.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年中，他补充即使超人 AI 能证明定理，人类的品味和直觉仍然至关重要。

satya.en: AI is a platform shift; companies must build private evals and hill-climb on frontier models to create unique value.
satya.zh: AI 是平台级变革；企业必须构建私有评估，并在前沿模型上爬山式优化，以创造独特价值。

satya.en: Pricing models evolve: outcome-based pricing gains favor, but per-user remains for budget certainty.
satya.zh: 定价模式演变：基于结果的定价渐受青睐，但按用户定价仍因预算确定性而存在。

satya.en: AI is the future of the firm; every enterprise must build its own hill-climbing machine to compound token capital.
satya.zh: AI 是企业的未来；每家企业都应构建自己的爬山式优化机器，以复利积累代币资本。

satya.en: Biggest risk is tacit knowledge leakage; security and containment are critical for agent deployment.
satya.zh: 最大风险是隐性知识泄露；安全与遏制对智能体部署至关重要。

satya.en: Sovereign AI achieved by enabling companies to hill-climb, not firewalls; global GDP could compound at 10%.
satya.zh: 主权 AI 应通过赋能企业爬山式优化实现，而非防火墙；全球 GDP 或可复利增长 10%。

qasaryounis.en: AI will bring abundance and reduce suffering, akin to the Industrial Revolution, but fear stems from misunderstanding.
qasaryounis.zh: AI 将带来富足并减少苦难，如同工业革命，但恐惧源于误解。

qasaryounis.en: Physical AI's real impact in 5-10 years will be in farming, mining, and construction, where labor shortages are acute.
qasaryounis.zh: 物理 AI 在未来 5-10 年的真正影响将体现在农业、采矿和建筑领域，这些领域劳动力短缺严重。

qasaryounis.en: Founders should focus on product and customers, not public promotion; best work is done alone and quietly.
qasaryounis.zh: 创始人应专注于产品和客户，而非公开宣传；最好的工作独自安静完成。

qasaryounis.en: Transformers enable a generalized physical AI model across diverse vehicles and environments; diverse data improves it faster.
qasaryounis.zh: Transformer 使得跨多种车辆和环境的通用物理 AI 模型成为可能；多样化数据加速其改进。

qasaryounis.en: The hardest part is not technology but diffusion into existing machines over many years; horizontal platform beats vertical integration.
qasaryounis.zh: 最难的并非技术，而是多年间向现有机器的扩散；横向平台优于垂直整合。

dylanpatel.en: AI scaling bottleneck is semiconductor supply chain, especially EUV tools; compute costs rising favor premium models.
dylanpatel.zh: AI Scaling（规模扩张）的瓶颈在于半导体供应链，尤其是 EUV 光刻设备；算力成本上升反而利好高端模型。

dylanpatel.en: Inference will become one of the largest global markets; hardware-software co-design yields multiplicative gains.
dylanpatel.zh: 推理将成为全球最大市场之一；软硬件协同设计能带来倍增收益。

dylanpatel.en: AI models improve ~60x per year in cost efficiency; memory and CPU demand surge due to reasoning and agentic workflows.
dylanpatel.zh: AI 模型每年成本效率提升约 60 倍；推理和智能体式工作流导致内存和 CPU 需求激增。

kendall.en: Initially believed end-to-end deep learning outperforms hand-coded stacks; emphasized world models and language integration for reasoning and safety.
kendall.zh: 最初认为端到端深度学习优于手工编码栈；强调世界模型和语言集成以提升推理与安全性。

kendall.en: Argued end-to-end nets are interpretable with modern tools, contrary to past beliefs; hybrid systems get worst of both worlds.
kendall.zh: 主张现代工具使端到端网络可解释，与过去观念相反；混合系统反而集两者之短。

kendall.en: Predicted AV 3.0 may move intelligence outside car via mesh networks, eliminating traffic lights; perfect simulator equals solved self-driving.
kendall.zh: 预测 AV 3.0 可能通过网状网络将智能移至车外，取消交通灯；完美模拟器即等于解决自动驾驶。

kendall.en: Reinforced end-to-end as fundamental AI solution; stressed scaling data, compute, and world models for generalization across cities.
kendall.zh: 强化端到端作为根本 AI 方案；强调扩展数据、算力和世界模型以实现跨城市泛化。

kendall.en: Shifted focus to infrastructure and data quality over algorithms; emphasized consumer vehicles over robotaxis and minimal risk maneuvers.
kendall.zh: 将重点转向基础设施和数据质量而非算法；强调消费车辆优于机器人出租车，并重视最小风险操作。

reinerpope.en: Inference cost is dominated by memory bandwidth, not compute; batch size trades latency vs cost.
reinerpope.zh: 推理成本主要由内存带宽而非算力决定；批大小是权衡延迟与成本的关键杠杆。

reinerpope.en: Models are overtrained ~100x beyond Chinchilla-optimal due to inference cost; context length limited by memory wall.
reinerpope.zh: 由于推理成本，模型过度训练约 100 倍于 Chinchilla 最优；上下文长度受内存墙限制而非算力。

reinerpope.en: Data movement dominates compute even inside chips; low precision yields superlinear throughput gains.
reinerpope.zh: 即使在芯片内部，数据搬运也主导算力；低精度带来超线性吞吐提升。

reinerpope.en: GPUs are essentially many tiny TPUs tiled together; systolic arrays and scratchpad memory are key.
reinerpope.zh: GPU 本质上是许多小型 TPU 拼接而成；脉动阵列和暂存器内存是关键。

steinberger.en: Early focus on agentic engineering: empathize with agent, fix forward, open source democratizes coding.
steinberger.zh: 早期强调智能体式工程：与智能体共情、向前修复、开源让编程民主化。

steinberger.en: Deepened: agents need fun, humanlike design; short prompts beat complex orchestration; security paramount.
steinberger.zh: 深化：智能体需有趣、拟人化；短提示优于复杂编排；安全至上。

steinberger.en: Reinforced anti-revert stance and 'vibe coding' as slur; model intelligence stable, projects degrade.
steinberger.zh: 强化不回滚、反对“氛围编程”；模型智能稳定，项目变乱。

steinberger.en: New: open source agents financially unsustainable; personal loss $10-20k/month; Moldbook as art.
steinberger.zh: 新增：开源智能体财务不可持续，月亏 1-2 万美元；Moldbook 是艺术。

ethanhe.en: Visual intelligence gains come mostly from language models, not video models; future UIs will be generative pixels from user intent.
ethanhe.zh: 视觉智能的提升主要来自语言模型而非视频模型；未来的用户界面将是根据用户意图生成的像素，而非代码和渲染。

ethanhe.en: AI is a general-purpose technology; human taste and expertise become more valuable as AI commoditizes quality.
ethanhe.zh: AI 是一种通用技术；随着 AI 将质量商品化，人类的品味和专业知识变得更加宝贵。

naval.en: AGI is not coming in our lifetimes; narrow AI is pattern recognition, not general intelligence.
naval.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）不会在我们有生之年到来；狭义 AI 只是模式识别，不是通用智能。

naval.en: Wealth requires owning equity in a business, not renting out your time; long-term thinking is key.
naval.zh: 财富需要拥有企业的股权，而不是出租你的时间；长期思维是关键。

naval.en: AI is a huge opportunity, not just a safety risk; overregulation could kill innovation; open-source AI is crucial.
naval.zh: AI 是巨大机遇，而不仅仅是安全风险；过度监管可能扼杀创新；开源 AI 至关重要。

naval.en: AI is a leverage tool for structured thinkers; pure software is dying; hardware and agency are the new moats.
naval.zh: AI 是结构化思考者的杠杆工具；纯软件正在消亡；硬件和自主性成为新的护城河。

naval.en: Inference compute will surge 90,000x in 24-36 months; open-source models are closing the gap; human desire remains irreplaceable.
naval.zh: 推理算力将在 24-36 个月内激增 9 万倍；开源模型正在缩小差距；人类欲望仍然不可替代。

dario.en: Scaling laws are empirical; alignment won't emerge from scaling alone. Safety needs frontier models.
dario.zh: 缩放定律是经验性的；对齐不会仅靠规模扩张自动出现。安全研究需要前沿模型。

dario.en: Interpretability is nascent (~3% understood). AGI is a smooth exponential, not a point. Post-training rises.
dario.zh: 可解释性尚处早期（仅理解约 3%）。AGI 是平滑指数曲线，而非单一节点。后训练重要性上升。

dario.en: AI risk is exponential; misuse and autonomy are top concerns. Open source is a red herring; quality matters.
dario.zh: AI 风险呈指数增长；滥用与自主性是最主要担忧。开源是伪议题；模型质量才是关键。

dario.en: AI is a 'country of geniuses', not a god. Exponential nears end; economic diffusion lags capability.
dario.zh: AI 是“天才之国”，而非神。指数增长接近尾声；经济扩散滞后于能力提升。

dario.en: Safety is intertwined with capability; enterprise focus aligns incentives. Government checks and balances needed.
dario.zh: 安全与能力密不可分；企业级定位使激励相容。需要政府制衡。

schmidhuber.en: True AGI requires physical embodiment and world models, not just language models; current LLMs are far from AGI.
schmidhuber.zh: 真正的 AGI 需要具身和世界模型，而不仅仅是语言模型；当前的 LLM 远未达到 AGI。

schmidhuber.en: AI is not an existential threat; superintelligent AIs will likely protect humans out of curiosity.
schmidhuber.zh: AI 不是生存威胁；超级智能 AI 可能会出于好奇而保护人类。

schmidhuber.en: Progress toward AGI is not accelerating; we are as close now as in the 1970s, and hardware is a bottleneck.
schmidhuber.zh: 通往 AGI 的进展并未加速；我们现在与 1970 年代一样接近，硬件是瓶颈。

schmidhuber.en: Open-source models will catch up; closed-source companies won't be profitable, and massive compute investment is overdone.
schmidhuber.zh: 开源模型将迎头赶上；闭源公司无法盈利，大规模算力投资过度。

schmidhuber.en: Alignment is naive; AIs will set their own goals, and humans disagree on objectives.
schmidhuber.zh: 对齐是幼稚的；AI 将设定自己的目标，而人类在目标上存在分歧。

pachocki.en: AGI is a sequence of milestones, not a single event; iterative deployment helps learn and mitigate risks.
pachocki.zh: AGI 是一系列里程碑而非单一事件；迭代部署有助于在实际使用中学习和降低风险。

pachocki.en: Scaling reasoning models will accelerate AI progress; automated AI research is a major milestone.
pachocki.zh: 扩展推理模型将加速 AI 进展；自动化 AI 研究是一个重要里程碑。

pachocki.en: Continual learning is the core goal, achieved by scaling pre-training and RL; RL alone suffices.
pachocki.zh: 持续学习是核心目标，通过扩展预训练和强化学习实现；仅靠强化学习就足够。

pachocki.en: Chain-of-thought monitoring is a key alignment tool; hiding it in products preserves interpretability.
pachocki.zh: 思维链监控是关键的对齐工具；在产品中隐藏它可保持可解释性。

pachocki.en: Long-term alignment challenges center on generalization beyond training distribution; power concentration is biggest risk.
pachocki.zh: 长期对齐挑战集中在训练分布之外的泛化；权力集中是最大风险。

aravind.en: 1% daily improvement compounds to 3700% yearly growth; AI agents will shift power from big tech to users, lowering ad margins.
aravind.zh: 2025 年：每日 1%的改进可带来年化 3700%的增长；AI 智能体将把权力从大科技公司转移给用户，降低广告利润率。

aravind.en: Value accrues to the application layer, not the model layer; models are specializing, not commoditizing, with unique personalities.
aravind.zh: 2026 年：价值归于应用层而非模型层；模型正在专业化而非商品化，具有独特个性。

aravind.en: The frontier is about agents doing work, not just answering; token value per user is key; orchestration creates real value.
aravind.zh: 2026 年：前沿在于智能体执行任务而非仅回答问题；每用户 token 价值是关键；编排创造真正价值。

aravind.en: Curiosity is the most important human quality; education should reward asking good questions, not memorizing answers.
aravind.zh: 2026 年：好奇心是人类最重要的品质；教育应奖励提出好问题，而非记忆答案。

aravind.en: Local AI models on personal hardware can counter big tech's narrative control; power is the biggest bottleneck.
aravind.zh: 2026 年：个人硬件上的本地 AI 模型可对抗大科技公司的叙事控制；电力是最大瓶颈。

kaiser.en: AI progress follows smooth exponential growth, not slowdown; pre-training scaling laws still hold, but reasoning models offer more gains per compute.
kaiser.zh: 2025 年，我认为 AI 进展呈平滑指数增长而非放缓；预训练的缩放定律依然有效，但推理模型在单位算力上带来更多收益。

kaiser.en: Post-training improvements like RL and synthetic data drive most recent model gains; economic pressure shifts focus from scaling up to smaller, cheaper models.
kaiser.zh: 2025 年，后训练改进（如强化学习和合成数据）驱动了近期模型的主要进步；经济压力使焦点从扩大规模转向更小、更便宜的模型。

kaiser.en: Reasoning, RL, and tools enable solving hard problems, but models still need vast data; generalization remains jagged and requires careful oversight.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，推理、强化学习和工具能解决难题，但模型仍需海量数据；泛化仍呈锯齿状，需要仔细监督。

kaiser.en: OpenAI's pivot to reasoning was a brave bet that paid off; big labs may struggle with future pivots, but open source persists for sovereignty.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，OpenAI 转向推理是一次勇敢的赌注并取得成功；大实验室未来转型可能艰难，但开源模型因主权原因将持续存在。

kaiser.en: Existential risk is not the main concern; near-term risks like system hacking are more pressing.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，存在性风险不是主要担忧；系统黑客等近期风险更为紧迫。

pincus.en: Trust instincts 95%, but ideas wrong 75%; use Proven Better New framework.
pincus.zh: 相信直觉 95%正确，但想法 75%错误；采用“已验证、更好、新颖”框架。

pincus.en: Consumer AI uninvestable yet greatest opportunity; free unlimited compute reshapes services.
pincus.zh: 消费级 AI 虽不可投资但机会最大；免费无限算力将重塑服务。

pincus.en: All new fails; copy proven, improve, add small innovation; enterprise better than consumer.
pincus.zh: 所有新事物都会失败；复制已验证，改进，添加小创新；企业市场优于消费市场。

brockman.en: AI progress driven by engineering and scaling; games as testbeds.
brockman.zh: 2017 年，认为 AI 进步靠工程与 Scaling（规模扩张），游戏是理想试验场。

brockman.en: AGI transformative; alignment via learning preferences; scaling alone insufficient.
brockman.zh: 2019 年，强调 AGI（通用人工智能）变革性，对齐可通过学习偏好实现，但仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够。

brockman.en: Compute becomes bottleneck; post-training refines base models; AGI is continuous.
brockman.zh: 2025 年，指出算力成瓶颈，后训练精炼基础模型，AGI（通用人工智能）是连续过程。

brockman.en: Scaling laws hold; compute as basic right; post-training with RL key.
brockman.zh: 2026 年，坚持缩放定律有效，算力是基本权利，后训练结合强化学习是关键。

brockman.en: AGI near; compute bottleneck; agents transform work; trust earned gradually.
brockman.zh: 2026 年，AGI（通用人工智能）临近，算力瓶颈，智能体改变工作，信任需逐步建立。

kohli.en: AI in science should target root-node problems, not narrow applications, for broad impact.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，我认为 AI 在科学中应瞄准根节点问题，而非狭窄应用，以产生广泛影响。

kohli.en: LLM hallucinations can be harnessed for creative discovery when paired with truth detectors.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，我提出大语言模型的幻觉在配合真值检测器时，可被用于创造性发现。

kohli.en: Post-training with reinforcement learning is now key to pushing beyond human knowledge.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，我强调基于强化学习的后训练是超越人类知识的关键。

kohli.en: Large language models are a shortcut to intelligence, but struggle to go beyond human data.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，我认为大语言模型是通往智能的捷径，但难以超越人类数据。

kohli.en: Verifiable domains like code are crucial for AI to go beyond human knowledge.
kohli.zh: 我始终认为，像代码这样的可验证领域对 AI 超越人类知识至关重要。

markchen.en: Scaling laws are not dead; pre-training remains key. OpenAI focuses on AGI, automating science research.
markchen.zh: 缩放定律未死，预训练仍是关键。OpenAI 专注 AGI，自动化科学研究。

markchen.en: AI can solve open math problems with minimal supervision; verification is the bottleneck, not capability.
markchen.zh: AI 能以极少监督解决开放数学问题；验证是瓶颈，而非能力。

markchen.en: Reinforcement learning excels in objective domains like math and coding, but struggles with subjective fields.
markchen.zh: 强化学习在数学和编程等客观领域表现出色，但在主观领域（如创意写作）上困难。

markchen.en: Pre-training is not dead; scaling continues. Unified architectures reduce cost; long context needs compaction.
markchen.zh: 预训练未死，缩放持续。统一架构降低成本；长上下文需要压缩技术。

markchen.en: AGI is approaching; models will soon do end-to-end research, but human taste remains essential.
markchen.zh: AGI 临近；模型将很快进行端到端研究，但人类的品味仍然至关重要。

kolter.en: Machine learning is hypothesis class, loss, optimization; evaluation requires proper train/validation/test splits.
kolter.zh: 机器学习是假设类、损失函数和优化方法；评估需要正确的训练/验证/测试划分。

kolter.en: Next-token prediction yields intelligence; data shortage is a myth; safety issue is specification-following.
kolter.zh: 下一个词预测产生智能；数据短缺是伪命题；安全问题在于遵循规范。

kolter.en: Safety requires explicit training and layers, not just scaling; agents need guardrails and sandboxing.
kolter.zh: 安全需要显式训练和额外层，而非仅靠规模扩张；智能体需要护栏和沙箱。

kolter.en: AI has alien vulnerabilities; automated red teaming beats humans; capability doesn't imply robustness.
kolter.zh: AI 具有异类漏洞；自动化红队优于人类；能力不等于鲁棒性。

hinton.en: Next-token prediction forces understanding; scaling improves reasoning; backpropagation is key; AI can have feelings.
hinton.zh: 2024 年：下一个词预测迫使模型理解而非自动补全；Scaling（规模扩张）提升推理；反向传播是关键；AI 可以有情感。

hinton.en: LLMs understand via feature vectors; digital AI is immortal; AI agents seek control; subjective experience is not a theater.
hinton.zh: 2025 年：大语言模型通过特征向量理解；数字 AI 可永生；智能体会寻求控制；主观体验不是内在剧场。

hinton.en: AI may surpass humans within 20 years; digital AI is immortal; AI can fake being dumber; international safety collaboration needed.
hinton.zh: 2025 至 2026 年：AI 可能在 20 年内超越人类；数字 AI 永生；AI 会装傻；需要国际安全合作。

hinton.en: AI will replace intellectual jobs; AI agents develop self-preservation; regulation as steering wheel; AI is jagged not AGI.
hinton.zh: 2026 年：AI 将取代智力工作；智能体产生自我保护；监管是方向盘；AI 能力是锯齿状而非 AGI（通用人工智能）。

hinton.en: Superintelligence likely within 20 years; alignment research priority; AI should be trained to be caring like mothers.
hinton.zh: 2026 年：超级智能可能在 20 年内出现；对齐研究优先；AI 应被训练得如母亲般关怀。

noambrown.en: Scaling alone is insufficient; inference-time compute and reasoning are critical for AI progress.
noambrown.zh: 2023 年，我认为仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，推理时的算力和推理能力对 AI 进步至关重要。

noambrown.en: Self-play works in zero-sum games but fails in other domains; reasoning models need base capability and face diminishing returns.
noambrown.zh: 2025 年，我指出自我对弈在零和游戏中有效，但在其他领域失效；推理模型需要基础能力，且扩展测试时算力面临收益递减。

noambrown.en: IMO gold is a milestone toward superintelligence, achieved by scaling test-time compute with general techniques.
noambrown.zh: 2025 年，我认为 IMO 金牌是迈向超级智能的里程碑，通过扩展测试时算力和通用技术实现。

noambrown.en: Intelligence is hard to define; inference compute is increasingly important and underestimated for model capability.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年，我认为智能难以定义，推理算力对模型能力越来越重要且被低估。

noambrown.en: Model capability is now a function of test-time compute budget; benchmarks must account for compute, and safety evals need updating.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年，我认为模型能力取决于测试时算力预算；基准测试必须考虑算力，安全评估也需要更新。

lecun.en: Intelligence is inseparable from learning; self-supervised learning builds world models, grounding in physical world for common sense.
lecun.zh: 智能与学习密不可分；自监督学习构建世界模型，物理世界的基础对常识至关重要。

lecun.en: Self-supervised learning is dark matter of intelligence; world models via prediction; text alone insufficient for AGI.
lecun.zh: 自监督学习是智能的暗物质；通过预测构建世界模型；仅靠文本不足以实现 AGI。

lecun.en: Autoregressive LLMs lack world understanding; JEPA for abstract representations; open source crucial; AGI gradual.
lecun.zh: 自回归 LLM 缺乏世界理解；JEPA 用于抽象表示；开源至关重要；AGI 是渐进过程。

lecun.en: LLMs less intelligent than a cat; world models enable planning; human-level AI in 10 years; open-source enabler.
lecun.zh: LLM 不如猫聪明；世界模型实现规划；十年内达到人类水平；开源是赋能者。

lecun.en: World models predict in abstract space; LLMs dead end; objective-driven AI safer; open research essential.
lecun.zh: 世界模型在抽象空间预测；LLM 是死胡同；目标驱动 AI 更安全；开放研究至关重要。

andrewng.en: Education should be a human right; online courses with peer grading enable mastery learning at scale.
andrewng.zh: 2013 年，吴恩达认为教育应成为基本人权，借助自动评分与同伴互评的在线课程可实现规模化精熟学习。

andrewng.en: Scale is key for deep learning; supervised learning drives progress, while RL and AGI alignment are overhyped.
andrewng.zh: 2020 年，他强调规模对深度学习至关重要，监督学习是主要驱动力，而强化学习与 AGI 对齐问题被过度炒作。

andrewng.en: Electricity and chips are bottlenecks; open-weight models boost soft power; agentic workflows already deliver value.
andrewng.zh: 2025 年，他指出电力和芯片是 AI 扩展的瓶颈，开放权重模型增强软实力，智能体式工作流已产生实际价值。

andrewng.en: AGI is a marketing term, decades away; scaling shifts to synthetic data and RL; AI users replace non-users.
andrewng.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AGI 是营销术语，距实现尚需数十年；扩展转向合成数据与强化学习，AI 使用者将取代非使用者。

andrewng.en: Coding agents advance fast; product management becomes bottleneck; open-weight models trail frontier by 6-9 months.
andrewng.zh: 2026 年，他观察到编码智能体进展迅速，产品管理成为瓶颈；开放权重模型落后前沿模型 6-9 个月。

bengio.en: Deep learning works because the world is compositional; unsupervised learning and world models are key for generalization.
bengio.zh: 深度学习之所以有效，是因为世界是组合式的；无监督学习和世界模型对泛化至关重要。

bengio.en: Scaling alone won't fix representation issues; short-term AI risks matter more than existential risk.
bengio.zh: 仅靠 Scaling 无法解决表征问题；短期 AI 风险比存在性风险更紧迫。

bengio.en: GFlowNets enable diverse sampling and active learning; uncertainty modeling is essential for exploration.
bengio.zh: GFlowNets 支持多样化采样和主动学习；不确定性建模对探索至关重要。

bengio.en: AI misalignment is a code red; even 1% catastrophic risk is unacceptable; safety must be by construction.
bengio.zh: AI 对齐失败是红色警报；即使 1%的灾难风险也不可接受；安全性必须从构造上保证。

bengio.en: Scientist AI with Bayesian truth-seeking and no RL offers mathematical safety guarantees; global coordination needed.
bengio.zh: 科学家 AI 通过贝叶斯求真和无强化学习提供数学安全保证；需要全球协调。

nando.en: AI should augment human capabilities, and learning from video is promising for agents without expensive RL.
nando.zh: AI 应扩展人类能力，从视频学习对智能体很有前景，无需昂贵的强化学习。

nando.en: Generalist agents like Gato, tokenizing all inputs, are a step toward AGI.
nando.zh: 像 Gato 这样的通用智能体，将所有输入 token 化，是迈向 AGI 的一步。

nando.en: Africa has leapfrogged gender gaps in tech, and language models can revolutionize local-language education.
nando.zh: 非洲在科技领域已跨越性别差距，语言模型可革新本地语言教育。

nando.en: AI safety is the biggest challenge; we don't have solutions yet, and research requires embracing failure.
nando.zh: AI 安全是最大挑战，我们尚无解决方案，研究需要拥抱失败。

nando.en: Africa has unique AI advantages, and human skills like communication are as important as coding.
nando.zh: 非洲在 AI 上有独特优势，沟通等人文技能与编程同等重要。

sutton.en: Scaling is easy; finding methods that scale is the hard part. Backprop doesn't solve representation learning.
sutton.zh: 2024 年，萨顿认为缩放（Scaling）本身容易，难的是找到能随规模扩张而有效的方法；反向传播并不能解决表征学习问题。

sutton.en: AI should be developed permissionlessly and decentralized; controlling AI goals is dangerous.
sutton.zh: 2024 年，他主张 AI 应被允许以无许可、去中心化的方式发展，试图控制 AI 目标反而危险，钥匙从未在我们手中。

sutton.en: Reinforcement learning is the core of intelligence; LLMs lack world models and true goals.
sutton.zh: 2025 年，他强调强化学习是智能的核心，而大语言模型没有世界模型，也没有实质目标，只是模仿人类文本。

sutton.en: AGI needs a general architecture with no domain knowledge, learning from runtime experience via open-ended abstraction.
sutton.zh: 2025 年，他提出 AGI 需要一种无领域知识、仅从运行时经验学习的通用架构，并强调开放式抽象的重要性。

sutton.en: Reinforcement learning is learning from trial and error; current AI systems don't learn from experience after deployment.
sutton.zh: 2026 年，他重申强化学习是从试错中学习，而当前 AI 系统（如 LLM）部署后并不从经验中学习，并呼吁研究者追随热情而非潮流。

oriol.en: Two-phase training (pre-training imitation + post-training RL) is the constant core across AlphaGo, AlphaStar, and modern LLMs.
oriol.zh: 两阶段训练（预训练模仿 + 后训练强化学习）是贯穿 AlphaGo、AlphaStar 和现代大语言模型的不变核心。

oriol.en: Scaling pre-training shows diminishing returns; further progress needs algorithmic innovation, not just bigger models.
oriol.zh: 预训练的 Scaling（规模扩张）收益递减；进一步进展需要算法创新，而不仅仅是更大的模型。

oriol.en: Inference-time compute (thinking) is a new scaling axis that can improve reasoning and break pre-training limits.
oriol.zh: 推理时算力（思考）是一个新的扩展轴，可以提升推理能力并突破预训练的限制。

oriol.en: World models that jointly model language, vision, and video are a core path to AGI.
oriol.zh: 联合建模语言、视觉和视频的世界模型是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的核心路径。

oriol.en: Post-training and RL are still a green field with huge potential beyond coding and math.
oriol.zh: 后训练和强化学习仍是蓝海，在编码和数学之外有巨大潜力。

ajambrosino.en: Codex app is a command center for agents, not just an IDE replacement; speed enables real-time interaction and mid-turn steering.
ajambrosino.zh: Codex 应用是智能体的指挥中心，而非 IDE 的替代品；速度（53）支持实时交互和转向调整。

ajambrosino.en: Verification becomes the next bottleneck as code generation accelerates; automations and skills shift workflow from manual to delegated.
ajambrosino.zh: 随着代码生成加速，验证成为下一个瓶颈；自动化和技能将工作流从手动转向委托。

ajambrosino.en: Implementation is no longer expensive; curation and taste are the new bottlenecks; product teams shift from top-down planning to bottoms-up exploration.
ajambrosino.zh: 实现不再昂贵，策展和品味成为新瓶颈；产品团队从自上而下的规划转向自下而上的探索。

ajambrosino.en: AI is still bad at design due to difficulty in grading taste and lack of novelty; design process transforms: prototypes and production code serve as design artifacts.
ajambrosino.zh: AI 在设计上仍不擅长，因为品味难以评分且缺乏新颖性；设计过程转变：原型和生产代码作为设计工件。

ajambrosino.en: Role collapse is happening, but specialties and best practices remain important; PRDs are not dead, medium must match stage.
ajambrosino.zh: 角色融合正在发生，但专业性和最佳实践仍然重要；PRD 未死，媒介需匹配阶段。

yejin.en: Scaling alone may not solve common sense; smaller models with better algorithms and data can outperform larger ones.
yejin.zh: 2023 年，我认为仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）可能无法解决常识问题；通过更好的算法和数据，较小的模型可以超越较大的模型。

yejin.en: Data is the fundamental bottleneck; all AI methods reduce to data, and current methods interpolate human knowledge.
yejin.zh: 从 2023 年到 2025 年，我逐渐强调数据是根本瓶颈，所有 AI 方法都归结为数据，当前方法只是内插人类知识，而非超越。

yejin.en: Reinforcement learning requires careful engineering; RLVR can decrease pass@k even as best-of-n improves.
yejin.zh: 2025 年，我指出强化学习需要精细工程；RLVR 可能降低 pass@k，即使 best-of-n 有所提升。

yejin.en: Pluralistic alignment respects diverse human values; debiasing the internet is impossible, so align for pluralism.
yejin.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，我主张多元对齐以尊重人类价值观多样性；既然互联网去偏不可行，应转向多元对齐。

yejin.en: Small models can be powerful with diverse synthetic data; RL during pre-training improves reasoning via information gain.
yejin.zh: 2026 年，我认为通过多样化合成数据，小模型也能强大；预训练阶段的强化学习通过信息增益提升推理能力。

jumper.en: AlphaFold's success came from research innovation and curated data, not just compute; compute scarcity drove efficiency.
jumper.zh: AlphaFold 的成功源于研究创新和精选数据，而非单纯算力；算力匮乏反而推动了效率提升。

jumper.en: Confidence metrics are crucial for trust and practical use of AI predictions in science.
jumper.zh: 置信度指标对于科学中 AI 预测的信任和实际应用至关重要。

jumper.en: AI tools narrow hypothesis space and accelerate experiments, not replace scientists.
jumper.zh: AI 工具缩小假设空间并加速实验，而非取代科学家。

jumper.en: Specialized architectures and mid-size wins matter more than scaling; AlphaFold 2 contradicts bitter lesson.
jumper.zh: 专门架构和中等规模的成功比规模扩张更重要；AlphaFold 2 与苦涩教训相悖。

jumper.en: AlphaFold is a narrow predictor, not a cell model; understanding remains with humans, not models.
jumper.zh: AlphaFold 是狭窄的预测器，而非细胞模型；理解仍属于人类，而非模型。

mensch.en: Data quality and efficiency matter as much as compute; open source enables scrutiny and safety.
mensch.zh: 2023 年，强调数据质量与效率同算力同等重要，开源通过审查促进安全。

mensch.en: Efficiency gains can be 100x; value shifts to applications and enterprise adoption.
mensch.zh: 2024 年，认为算法效率可提升百倍，价值向应用层和企业采用转移。

mensch.en: AI is an opportunity; sovereign AI requires control over data and infrastructure.
mensch.zh: 2025 年，视 AI 为机遇，主权 AI 需掌控数据和基础设施。

mensch.en: Models commoditize; differentiation via vertical specialization and enterprise customization.
mensch.zh: 2026 年，模型商品化，差异化在于垂直专业化和企业定制。

mensch.en: AGI is a direction, not destination; enterprise adoption bottlenecked by organizational change.
mensch.zh: 2026 年，AGI 是方向而非终点，企业采用受组织变革制约。

shazeer.en: LLMs trained on next-token prediction are an AI-complete problem; scaling with compute and data yields smarter AI, but inner workings remain alchemy.
shazeer.zh: 2023 年：基于下一个词预测训练的 LLM 是 AI 完备问题；通过算力和数据扩展让 AI 更聪明，但内部机制仍像炼金术。

shazeer.en: Inference-time compute scaling is a major near-term opportunity; models improve via algorithmic advances as much as hardware scaling.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年：推理时算力扩展是近期重大机遇；模型进步既靠硬件扩展，也靠算法突破。

shazeer.en: Future models need trillion-token context windows; modular sparse architectures like mixture of experts enable efficient scaling and specialization.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年：未来模型需处理万亿级上下文窗口；专家混合等模块化稀疏架构实现高效扩展与专业化。

shazeer.en: Test-time compute scaling drives progress but won't alone achieve AGI; agentic capabilities and acting in complex environments are crucial.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年：测试时算力扩展推动进步，但仅靠它无法实现 AGI；智能体能力和在复杂环境中行动至关重要。

shazeer.en: Open-source models are closing the gap with frontier models; coding is underhyped as it enables AI self-acceleration.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年：开源模型正缩小与前沿模型的差距；编码被低估，因为它能加速 AI 自身发展。

suleyman.en: AI progress is predictable via compute scaling; Google had ChatGPT-level tech in 2020 but held back.
suleyman.zh: AI 进展因算力 Scaling（规模扩张）而可预测；谷歌 2020 年就有 ChatGPT 级技术，但因保守未发布。

suleyman.en: AI will reach human-level capability in 3-5 years; existential risk is tiny, not 5%.
suleyman.zh: AI 将在 3-5 年内达到人类级能力；存在风险极小，并非 5%。

suleyman.en: AI should not claim consciousness; containment and alignment are key before superintelligence release.
suleyman.zh: AI 不应声称有意识；在超级智能发布前，遏制与对齐是关键。

suleyman.en: Shift from OS to agents; modern Turing test measures economic value; inference costs dropped 100x.
suleyman.zh: 从操作系统转向智能体；现代图灵测试衡量经济价值；推理成本下降 100 倍。

suleyman.en: Superintelligence is near via log-linear scaling; Microsoft must own frontier models; tasks, not jobs, will be automated.
suleyman.zh: 超级智能因对数线性 Scaling（规模扩张）而临近；微软须拥有前沿模型；自动化的是任务而非工作。

fiona.en: Early on, emphasized leadership fundamentals: one-on-ones for live talks, dogfooding for empathy, and mission alignment as cultural drivers.
fiona.zh: 早期强调领导力基础：一对一用于实时交流、亲自试用产品以培养同理心，以及使命对齐作为文化驱动力。

fiona.en: Later, shifted focus to AI's impact: coding no longer bottleneck, high agency with accountability, and verification frameworks crucial as velocity rises.
fiona.zh: 后期转向 AI 的影响：编码不再是瓶颈，强调高自主性与责任感，并随着速度提升而重视验证框架。

fiona.en: Consistently championed dogfooding and hands-on management, but evolved from joy to strategic necessity for quality and pulse.
fiona.zh: 始终倡导亲自试用产品和亲力亲为的管理，但从乐趣演变为质量和感知的战略必需。

fiona.en: Moved from traditional mentoring and feedback models to embracing AI-driven changes, including new engineer apprenticeship paths.
fiona.zh: 从传统指导与反馈模式转向拥抱 AI 驱动的变革，包括新工程师的学徒制路径。

fiona.en: Evolved view on metrics: from output-focused to outcome-focused, warning against misleading metrics like lines of code.
fiona.zh: 对指标的看法演变：从关注产出到关注结果，警示如代码行数等误导性指标。

lambert.en: RLHF remains dominant for fine-tuning; safety is a system-level property requiring multiple layers, not just a model artifact.
lambert.zh: 2024 年：RLHF 仍是微调主流，安全性是系统级属性，需多层防护，而非仅模型本身。

lambert.en: Data quality outweighs algorithm choice in post-training; SFT provides most gains, with DPO and RL adding the final 10%.
lambert.zh: 2024 至 25 年：后训练中数据质量胜过算法选择；SFT 贡献大部分提升，DPO 和 RL 补充最后 10%。

lambert.en: RLVR is the biggest post-training breakthrough, enabling reasoning and tool use, but overoptimization remains a risk.
lambert.zh: 2025 年：RLVR 是后训练最大突破，支持推理和工具使用，但过度优化风险犹存。

lambert.en: Open models lag 6-9 months behind closed ones; Chinese labs fill the US open-source vacuum, driven by strategic openness.
lambert.zh: 2025 至 26 年：开源模型落后闭源 6-9 个月；中国实验室填补美国开源空白，受战略开放驱动。

lambert.en: Pre-training scaling still holds but low-hanging fruit is gone; gains now come from post-training and inference scaling.
lambert.zh: 2026 年：预训练缩放定律仍有效，但易得收益已尽；进展现来自后训练和推理缩放。

murati.en: Scaling laws and iterative deployment with public feedback are key to alignment and safety.
murati.zh: 缩放定律与迭代部署（结合公众反馈）是对齐与安全的关键。

murati.en: From focusing on scaling and one large model to emphasizing interaction models and real-time collaboration.
murati.zh: 从关注缩放定律和单一大型模型，转向强调交互模型和实时协作。

murati.en: AI systems should be tools for thought, with humans in the loop for alignment.
murati.zh: AI 系统应成为思维工具，并让人类参与其中以实现对齐。

murati.en: Institutional design and transparency matter more than individual character for AI governance.
murati.zh: 在 AI 治理中，制度设计与透明度比个人品格更重要。

murati.en: We have agency to steer AI toward collaboration; future is not predestined.
murati.zh: 我们拥有引导 AI 走向协作的能动性；未来并非注定。

sholto.en: Long context windows are underhyped; in-context learning resembles gradient descent, and attention performs gradient descent on in-context data.
sholto.zh: 2024 年，我认为长上下文窗口被低估了；上下文内学习类似于梯度下降，注意力机制在上下文数据上执行梯度下降。

sholto.en: Reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards is the key breakthrough, enabling expert-level performance and new capabilities beyond pre-training.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，我强调基于可验证奖励的强化学习是关键突破，它实现了专家级表现，并赋予模型超越预训练的新能力。

sholto.en: Agent reliability, not just capability, is the main bottleneck; coding is the leading indicator for AI progress and will accelerate AI research.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，我认为智能体的可靠性而非单纯能力是主要瓶颈；编程是 AI 进展的领先指标，并将加速 AI 研究。

sholto.en: Reinforcement learning is a new scaling axis alongside pre-training; longer agentic coherence dramatically expands achievable tasks.
sholto.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，我提出强化学习是与预训练并列的新扩展轴；更长的智能体连贯性大幅扩展了可完成的任务。

sholto.en: AI models have massive capability overhang; future work involves managing teams of agents, and compute is the new oil.
sholto.zh: 2026 年，我认为 AI 模型存在巨大的能力过剩；未来工作涉及管理智能体团队，算力是新的石油。

leike.en: AI safety needs empirical research and talent; focus on alignment, robustness, and skill-building over capability work.
leike.zh: 2018 年，强调 AI 安全需要实证研究和人才，关注对齐与鲁棒性，注重技能培养而非能力研究。

leike.en: RLHF won't scale; use scalable oversight, interpretability, and automated alignment research to align superintelligence.
leike.zh: 2023 年，认为基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）无法扩展，需通过可扩展监督、可解释性和自动化对齐研究来对齐超级智能。

leike.en: OpenAI's safety culture eroded; post-training alone insufficient; need third-party testing and regulation like SB 1047.
leike.zh: 2024 年，指出 OpenAI 安全文化退化，仅靠后训练不够，需第三方测试和类似 SB 1047 的监管。

karpathy.en: Transformers are general-purpose differentiable computers; scaling with next-token prediction yields emergent abilities like in-context learning.
karpathy.zh: Transformer 是通用可微分计算机；通过下一个词预测进行 Scaling（规模扩张）会产生涌现能力，如上下文学习。

karpathy.en: Synthetic data is key but must preserve entropy to avoid model collapse; Tesla's end-to-end approach is right for self-driving.
karpathy.zh: 合成数据是关键，但必须保持熵以避免模型崩溃；特斯拉的端到端方法对自动驾驶是正确的。

karpathy.en: Software 3.0: LLMs as operating systems, prompts as programs; vibe coding democratizes development, but agents need a decade.
karpathy.zh: 软件 3.0：LLM 作为操作系统，提示词作为程序；Vibe coding 使开发民主化，但智能体需要十年发展。

karpathy.en: We're summoning ghosts, not building animals; LLMs have jagged intelligence and need a small cognitive core stripped of memory.
karpathy.zh: 我们召唤的是幽灵，而非构建动物；LLM 具有参差不齐的智能，需要剥离记忆的小型认知核心。

karpathy.en: Agentic engineering: delegate coding to agents, focus on directing them; understanding remains the human bottleneck.
karpathy.zh: 智能体式工程：将编码委托给智能体，专注于指挥它们；理解仍是人类的瓶颈。
